public_rationale: The blanket claim faces material counterevidence: contemporaneous reporting describes Midjourney as a profitable business with paid AI subscriptions. But the accessible report does not define profit or isolate subscription economics. The claim also supplies no accounting basis or financial test. The records therefore do not justify either supporting the universal assertion or treating this candidate counterexample as a fully matched financial contradiction.
limitations: The counterevidence is secondary reporting, not public accounts.
A profitable company may have other revenue sources.
Positive gross margins alone would not establish sustainable company-wide profitability.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The underlying economics suggest that no subscription-based AI service, let alone a free one, makes any kind of financial sense.

statement.excerpt: The underlying economics suggest that no subscription-based AI service — let alone a free one — makes any kind of financial sense

from_speaker: makes any kind of financial sense
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a claim about provider economics: no subscription AI service has an economically viable model.
A credible example of an AI subscription service covering its recurring costs would count against the universal assertion.
Suggest qualifies the strength of the assertion; it is not an external condition that must occur.
Use Q1 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post that public reporting could describe.
No accounting basis or particular margin measure is supplied. Do not silently replace financial viability with either gross margin or net income.
criteria.support_condition: Broad, comparable financial evidence establishes that the covered subscription services cannot cover the costs required to sustain their services.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one service within the claimed scope credibly demonstrates financially viable subscription economics in the target period under a defined accounting basis.
